messages:
leila: FYI planning note: we need a short migration doc & snippet for the Ruby SDK because the old `models` endpoint is being removed in v2 and replaced with `model_versions`. Customers on older samples are seeing 404s when they follow quickstart. Putting a PR together.

dan: Ugh. Which Ruby gem versions are affected? I can update snippets in the guides and the quickstart repo.

leila: Affected: ruby-sdk < 1.8.0 (the adapter used `client.models.get` vs `client.model_versions.get`). In most samples we call `client.models['gpt-foo']` which now errors with: "NoMethodError: undefined method `models' for #<Redwood::Client>"

maya: Do we have a canonical replacement snippet for Ruby? If not, let's add one and include a tiny compatibility shim for users who pin old gems.

frank: Here's a minimal v2 snippet for the guides (sync style):

```ruby
# v2: list model versions and pick by tag
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
model_versions = client.model_versions.list(model: 'rw-embed')
chosen = model_versions.find { |mv| mv.tags.include?('stable') }
resp = client.generate(model: chosen.id, input: 'hello')
puts resp.output_text
```

dan: Looks good. For quickstart we usually show the simplest call: `client.generate(model: 'rw-embed-stable', input: ...)`. Maybe add both patterns (explicit lookup vs direct by alias) and explain aliasing.

leila: Good call. Also add a Troubleshooting note for CI: some teams have automated tests that parse the JSON response shape and expect `model.name` — now it's `model_version.id`. Example error message we've seen: "KeyError: 'models' not found in response". Add exact strings to help search.

frank: For compatibility, we can ship this tiny shim (last-resort):

```ruby
# shim: provide legacy `models` accessor on the client for older apps
class Redwood::Client
  def models
    @models_proxy ||= ModelsProxy.new(self)
  end
end

class ModelsProxy
  def initialize(client)
    @client = client
  end
  def [](name)
    # translate to model_versions lookup; not ideal but helps migrations
    mv = @client.model_versions.list(model: name).find { |m| m.tags.include?('stable') }
    raise "Model not found: #{name}" unless mv
    mv
  end
end
```

leila: Add a big WARNING: "This shim is a temporary stopgap. Upgrade the gem to >=1.8.0 and adopt model_versions." Mark as last-resort in docs.

dan: Logistics: We need these changes in three places: quickstart, guides/migration, and the ruby examples repo. I'll open PRs and link them in this thread.

leila: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5230 (migration guide), https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-ruby/pull/88 (quickstart example), https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-examples/pull/212 (examples update).

frank: CI: ops-bot, can you run snippet smoke on the quickstart repo across ruby 2.7/3.0/3.2? We had a subtle keyword-args mismatch causing failures.

ops-bot: Smoke run queued: job #4567 for quickstart-ruby. Results: ruby-2.7: failed (keyword args deprecation), ruby-3.0: passed, ruby-3.2: passed. See actions: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-ruby/actions/runs/4567

leila: Noted. We should add a short note in migration guide: "If using Ruby < 3.0, ensure your gem's keyword arg handling is compatible; prefer Ruby >= 3.0."

dan: Also add a redirect from /v1/ruby/models to /v2/ruby/model_versions. I'll create the docs redirect ticket.

leila: Can someone craft release-notes blurb for customers? Keep it short and actionable. Draft: "We are removing the legacy `models` accessor in the SDK; use `model_versions` or direct model aliases. See migration guide for Ruby examples."

frank: Minor edit: add example alias line: `model: 'rw-embed-stable'` as the easiest migration path.

leila: Great. I'll merge staging PR once quickstart CI passes or we add a fallback note. Thanks team. Closing after backport to stable branch.

ops-bot: Created ticket DOCS-804 and added PRs to column "deprecation-ruby". :white_check_mark:
